places.name: Amber (Amer) Fort
places.ai_summary: A majestic fort and palace complex with stunning architecture, overlooking Maota Lake, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

opening_hours.notes: Light and sound show in the evening.

places.place_tip: Take an elephant ride to the fort entrance for a unique experience.
places.advanced_booking: Recommended for the light and sound show

places.name: City Palace Jaipur
places.ai_summary: A royal residence and museum showcasing the grandeur of Rajasthani architecture and the history of Jaipur’s royal family.

opening_hours.notes: Night tours available with prior booking.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum to see royal artifacts and costumes.

wikimedia_commons.source_file: File:City Palace Aerial View by Pranshu Dubey.jpg

attribution.title: City Palace Aerial View by Pranshu Dubey
attribution.author: Pranshu Dubey

places.name: Hawa Mahal
places.ai_summary: The iconic ‘Palace of Winds,’ a five-story structure with intricate latticework, offering panoramic views of Jaipur.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Climb to the top for the best views of the city.

places.name: Jantar Mantar Jaipur
places.ai_summary: An astronomical observatory with impressive stone instruments for measuring time and celestial bodies, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available.

places.place_tip: Hire a guide to understand the functioning of the instruments.

places.name: Nahargarh Fort
places.ai_summary: A hilltop fort offering stunning views of the Pink City, with a beautiful palace and gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunset.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a meal at the fort's restaurant with a view.

places.name: Jaigarh Fort
places.ai_summary: A formidable fort known for its impressive architecture, massive walls, and the world's largest cannon on wheels.

opening_hours.notes: Combine visit with Amber Fort.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the museum inside the fort.

attribution.title: Aravalli Hills
attribution.author: The original uploader was P.K.Niyogi at English Wikipedia.

places.name: Jal Mahal (Water Palace view)
places.ai_summary: A beautiful palace located in the middle of Man Sagar Lake, offering a picturesque view, especially at sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed from the shore; boating not allowed.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby gardens for a better view.

wikimedia_commons.source_file: File:A close look to Jal Mahal.jpg

attribution.title: A close look to Jal Mahal
attribution.author: Akku09102004

places.name: Albert Hall Museum
places.ai_summary: The oldest museum in Rajasthan, displaying an extensive collection of artifacts, including paintings, jewelry, and weapons.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Fridays.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the Egyptian mummy and the Persian carpet.
places.address: Albert Hall Museum, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India

places.name: Birla Mandir (Laxmi Narayan Temple)
places.ai_summary: A modern Hindu temple made of white marble, dedicated to Lord Vishnu and Goddess Laxmi, known for its serene ambiance.

opening_hours.notes: Visit during thearti (prayer ceremony) for a spiritual experience.

places.place_tip: The temple is beautifully lit at night.

places.name: Galtaji Temple (Monkey Temple)
places.ai_summary: An ancient Hindu pilgrimage site with natural springs and stunning architecture, located in a scenic gorge.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Be cautious of monkeys; they can be mischievous.

places.name: Sisodia Rani Palace and Garden
places.ai_summary: A beautiful palace with stunning gardens, offering a peaceful retreat and a glimpse into Rajasthan’s royal history.

opening_hours.notes: Combine visit with a trip to the nearby observatory.

places.place_tip: The gardens are perfect for a leisurely stroll.
places.address: Sisodia Rani Palace, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India

places.name: Independence Memorial
places.ai_summary: A memorial dedicated to the martyrs of the Indian independence movement, featuring impressive architecture and serene gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: The gardens are a great place for a picnic.

wikimedia_commons.source_file: File:56 Signers of the Declaration of Independence Memorial (2dc161f6-4699-4bac-8437-bdd5e198b6ba).jpg

attribution.title: 56 Signers of the Declaration of Independence Memorial
attribution.author: NPS Photo

places.name: Rambagh Palace
places.ai_summary: A former royal palace now converted into a luxury hotel, showcasing stunning architecture and sprawling gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Now a luxury hotel, prior booking required for entry.

places.place_tip: Enjoy high tea in the palace for a royal experience.

places.name: Jawahar Circle
places.ai_summary: A large circular park with a beautiful garden, fountains, and a walking path, ideal for a leisurely stroll or a picnic.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: The park is beautifully landscaped and well-maintained.

places.name: Central Park
places.ai_summary: A large urban park in the city center, featuring gardens, walking paths, and a lake, perfect for relaxation and recreation.

opening_hours.notes: Ideal for morning walks and evening relaxation.

places.place_tip: The park has a variety of flora and fauna.

places.name: Sanganer
places.ai_summary: A town famous for its handmade paper and textile printing industry, offering a glimpse into traditional Rajasthani craftsmanship.

opening_hours.notes: Visit the local workshops to see artisans at work.

places.place_tip: Don't forget to buy some souvenirs.

places.name: Chokhi Dhani
places.ai_summary: A cultural village resort that offers a glimpse into Rajasthani village life, with traditional food, music, and dance.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended, especially for dinner.

places.place_tip: Try the Rajasthani thali for an authentic meal.

wikimedia_commons.source_file: File:Al Fanar Seafood Restaurant, Al Seef.jpg

attribution.title: Al Fanar Seafood Restaurant, Al Seef
attribution.author: RPSkokie

places.name: Elefantastic
places.ai_summary: An elephant sanctuary and experience center where visitors can interact with elephants in a natural and ethical environment.

opening_hours.notes: Prior booking required, especially for the lunch package.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable clothes and shoes.

places.name: Jaipur Wax Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum featuring lifelike wax statues of famous personalities, offering a unique and entertaining experience.

opening_hours.notes: Photography not allowed inside the museum.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum's gift shop for unique souvenirs.
places.address: Jaipur Wax Museum, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India

places.name: Panna Meena ka Kund
places.ai_summary: A beautiful stepwell with intricate carvings and a serene atmosphere, perfect for photography and relaxation.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: The stepwell is a great spot for photography.
places.address: Panna Meena ka Kund, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India

places.name: Shesh Mahal
places.ai_summary: A beautiful palace with stunning mirror work and intricate carvings, offering a glimpse into the royal past of Jaipur.

opening_hours.notes: Combine visit with Amber Fort.

places.place_tip: The mirror work is best seen up close.

places.name: Kanak Ghati
places.ai_summary: A beautiful garden and temple complex, offering a peaceful retreat and stunning views of the surrounding hills.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: The gardens are perfect for a peaceful stroll.

places.name: Maharaniyon Ki Chhatri
places.ai_summary: A beautiful cenotaph with intricate carvings and a serene atmosphere, dedicated to the queens of Jaipur.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: The carvings are intricate and worth admiring up close.
places.address: Maharaniyon Ki Chhatri, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India

places.name: Raj Mandir Cinema
places.ai_summary: An iconic cinema hall in Jaipur, known for its grand architecture and interior design, offering a unique movie-watching experience.

opening_hours.notes: Book tickets in advance for popular shows.

places.place_tip: Try to catch a Bollywood movie for the full experience.
places.address: Raj Mandir Cinema, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India

places.name: Birla Planetarium
places.ai_summary: A modern planetarium offering fascinating shows about space and astronomy, providing an educational and entertaining experience.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for show timings.

places.place_tip: The planetarium is located in a beautiful park.

places.name: Nahargarh Biological Park
places.ai_summary: A large park and zoo area at Nahargarh Fort, home to a variety of animals and birds, offering a natural retreat within the city.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Carry water and snacks, as facilities are limited inside.
places.address: Nahargarh Biological Park, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India

places.name: Elephant City
places.ai_summary: A unique experience center where visitors can learn about and interact with elephants in a sustainable and ethical manner.

opening_hours.notes: Prior booking required, especially for the lunch package.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable clothes and shoes.

places.name: Jaipur Literature Festival
places.ai_summary: An annual literary festival featuring renowned authors, poets, and thinkers from around the world, offering engaging discussions and book signings.

opening_hours.notes: Usually held in January, exact dates vary each year.

places.place_tip: Book accommodations well in advance during the festival period.
places.address: Jaipur Literature Festival, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
